scientific_integrity: Complete finite proof by exhaustively enumerated objects, exact integer dynamic programming and independently evaluated order optimizations; all executable checks completed. No claims of infinite-dimensional generalization or external audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact anti-forcing census is restricted to hypercube dimensions at most four. The maximum degree and its four extremizers in dimension four are credited to previously published theory. The full 2004 source on hypercube ordinary forcing was unavailable; an unindexed earlier full-spectrum computation remains a novelty risk. The result is not independently certified.
title: First gapped anti-forcing spectrum in the hypercube sequence
